def VTask.subtypePreimage : {α : Sort u_1} -> {β : Sort u_4} -> (p : α → Prop) -> [DecidablePred p] -> (x₀ : { a // p a } → β) -> { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } ≃ ({ a // ¬p a } → β) := by
  intro α β p _ x₀

    intro ⟨x₁, hx₁⟩ ⟨x₂, hx₂⟩ h

    have h₂ : x₂ ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := hx₂
    have h₃ : F ⟨x₁, hx₁⟩ = F ⟨x₂, hx₂⟩ := h

      intro ⟨a, ha⟩
      have h₅ : F ⟨x₁, hx₁⟩ ⟨a, ha⟩ = F ⟨x₂, hx₂⟩ ⟨a, ha⟩ := by rw [h₃]
      simp [F] at h₅ ⊢
      <;> exact h₅
    have h₅ : x₁ = x₂ := by
      funext a
      by_cases ha : p a
      · have h₆ : x₁ a = x₀ ⟨a, ha⟩ := by

          have h₈ : (x₂ ∘ Subtype.val) ⟨a, ha⟩ = x₀ ⟨a, ha⟩ := by
            rw [hx₂]
            <;> rfl
          simp [Function.comp_apply] at h₈ ⊢

    have h₁ : F (G y) = y := by

      funext ⟨a, ha⟩

    invFun := G
